title: 第391章 番外：公主入魔？
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白

第(1/3)页

君卿颜望着面前的盒子，并未伸手接，只笑了笑道：“你的俸禄远不及我的月银多，还是攒着以后买大宅子吧。况且你给我们当了近半年的陪练，期间没有接受我们给的酬劳，我又怎么好再收你的礼？”

“我还是攒了不少银子的。”谢霖连忙接话，“给公主买一件礼物不要紧。”

“你当初说，在遇见我们之前，身边没有真心对待你的人，所以你斗胆将我们当做你的好朋友，既然是朋友，你若只给我一人送礼，不给其他人送，岂不是说不过去？”

君卿颜悠悠道，“可我若是叫你把其他人的礼物也补上，那你就得花更多银子了，想想实在没这个必要，你还是干脆都别送，真要送，等以后挣大钱了再说吧。”

谢霖闻言，不禁有些窘迫。

“公主，其实……”他犹豫了片刻，终究还是鼓起勇气道了一句，“你与其他人是不一样的。”

君卿颜听着这话，并不觉得意外，轻挑了一下眉梢，“哪里不一样？”

谢霖正要回答，余光却瞥见地上有物体在移动，转头看去，便见一条橙红色的小蛇吐着信子，朝君卿颜所在的位置弓起了身躯。

谢霖面色一变，“公主小心！”

说话间，他迅速出手将君卿颜推开！

君卿颜跌倒在一旁，几乎是同时，那条小蛇的身躯窜了出去，谢霖来不及收回手，被小蛇咬了手腕。

君卿颜转头看到这一幕，也是一惊。

而谢霖已经用另一只手抓住了小蛇的七寸，将整条小蛇缠起，狠狠摔在地上踩了一脚，携着内力的劲道，足以将小蛇踩死。

君卿颜连忙上前抓起谢霖的手，见伤口处呈现黑紫色，便知这小蛇有毒。

小蛇的颜色几乎与花田融为一体，且它发动攻击的位置处于她的视野盲区，若不是谢霖眼尖地将她推开，此刻被蛇咬的人就是她了。

不过……其实被咬了也不打紧，他们这一行人里，可是有一位神医后人。

“小月！”君卿颜转头朝远处放风筝的江浸月喊了一声，“先别放风筝了，快过来！”

说着，她从衣袖口袋内侧掏出了一个药盒，拿了一粒药丸给谢霖，“这药丸清热解毒，针对寻常的蛇毒有缓解之效，先吃一颗。”

谢霖吃下了药丸，江浸月很快也赶了回来，“怎么了这是？”

“谢霖被毒蛇咬了，你来看看。”

江浸月连忙替谢霖把了脉，而后转身去拿药箱。

她从药箱里挑了一株草药砸碎，让谢霖喝下了药汁，再将剩下的碎草药敷在伤口处。

“银针逼毒法，我之前可是教过你的，你没忘记吧？”江浸月朝君卿颜说道，“眼下就是实践的好机会，你来试试。”

说话间，她将针包递到了君卿颜面前。

君卿颜抽了一下唇角，“拿他来试吗？”

“他现在已经性命无忧了，就差把余毒清出来。你尽管试，不行的话还有我呢！反正他最后肯定会没事。”

“就依县主所言。”谢霖接话道，“我这会儿不觉得难受，公主既然学了医术，必得实践一番，试试也无妨。”

见谢霖也没意见，君卿颜便接过了针包，“也罢，那我就来试试。”

接下来的时间里，江浸月便认真指导起了君卿颜。

“不错，就是这个位置。”

“这次扎浅了，往里再扎一点儿。”

“萃取解毒汁的时间不能太短，否则效果不好，久一点倒是不要紧。”

“对对对，就是这样，我们颜颜果然记性好，一教就会。”

良久之后，解毒彻底完成，君卿颜拔了谢霖身上的银针，问他道：“这会儿感觉如何？”

“手臂有些无力，除此之外，没有其他不适。”

“这是正常的。”江浸月解释道，“身体需要适应药效，药都用在你这条胳膊上了，所以你会觉得使不上劲，过一两个时辰就好，话说回来，好端端的，怎么就让蛇给咬了？”

Jun Qingyan looked at the box in front of her, but did not reach out to take it. She just smiled and said: "Your salary is far less than my monthly salary, so you should save it to buy a big house later. Besides, you have been our sparring partner for nearly half a year, and you have not accepted any compensation from us during this period. How can I accept any more gifts from you?"

"I still saved a lot of money." Xie Lin quickly answered, "It doesn't matter if I buy a gift for the princess."

"You said at the beginning that before you met us, there was no one around you who treated you sincerely, so you dared to treat us as your good friends. Since we are friends, wouldn't it be justified if you only gave gifts to me and not to others?"

Jun Qingyan said leisurely, "But if I ask you to make up for other people's gifts, then you will have to spend more money. Thinking about it, it is not necessary, so you might as well not give them at all. If you really want to give them, wait until you make a lot of money."

Xie Lin couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed when he heard this.

"Princess, actually..." He hesitated for a moment, and finally mustered up the courage to say, "You are different from others."

Jun Qingyan was not surprised when he heard this, and raised her eyebrows slightly, "What's the difference?"

Xie Lin was about to answer when he caught a glimpse of something moving on the ground out of the corner of his eye. He turned around and saw a small orange-red snake spitting out a message and arching its body towards Jun Qingyan's position.

Xie Lin's expression changed, "Princess, be careful!"

As he spoke, he quickly pushed Jun Qingyan away!

Jun Qingyan fell to the side, and almost at the same time, the body of the little snake sprang out. Xie Lin had no time to take back his hand, and was bitten on the wrist by the snake.

Jun Qingyan turned around and was shocked when she saw this scene.

Xie Lin had already grabbed seven inches of the little snake with his other hand, wrapped the whole snake up, threw it to the ground and stepped on it. With the strength of his internal force, it was enough to crush the little snake to death.

Jun Qingyan quickly stepped forward and grabbed Xie Lin's hand. When she saw that the wound was black and purple, she knew that the little snake was poisonous.

The color of the little snake almost blended in with the flower field, and the position where it attacked was in the blind spot of her vision. If Xie Lin hadn't pushed her away with sharp eyes, she would have been the one bitten by the snake at this moment.

But... it actually doesn't matter if he gets bitten. Among their group, there is a descendant of a miracle doctor.

"Xiaoyue!" Jun Qingyan turned around and shouted to Jiang Jinyue, who was flying a kite in the distance, "Stop flying the kite now, come here quickly!"

As she said that, she took out a medicine box from the inside of her sleeve pocket and gave Xie Lin a pill. "This pill clears away heat and detoxifies. It has an alleviating effect on common snake venom. Take one first."

Xie Lin took the pill, and Jiang Jinyue quickly rushed back, "What's wrong?"

"Xie Lin was bitten by a poisonous snake. Come and take a look."

Jiang Jinyue quickly checked Xie Lin's pulse, then turned around to get the medicine box.

She picked an herb from the medicine box, smashed it, made Xie Lin drink the concoction, and then applied the remaining crushed herb to the wound.

"I have taught you the silver needle poisoning method before, have you forgotten it?" Jiang Jinyue said to Jun Qingyan, "Now is a good opportunity to practice it, come and try it."

As she spoke, she handed the needle bag to Jun Qingyan.

Jun Qingyan twitched the corners of her lips and said, "Try him?"

"His life is safe now. We just need to clean out the remaining poison. Just try, but if it doesn't work, I will be there! Anyway, he will be fine in the end."

"It's just what the county master said." Xie Lin answered, "I don't feel uncomfortable at the moment. Since the princess has learned medical skills, she must practice it, so there is no harm in giving it a try."

Seeing that Xie Lin had no objection, Jun Qingyan took the needle pack and said, "Well, I'll give it a try."

In the following time, Jiang Jinyue carefully guided Jun Qingyan.

"Yes, this is the location."

"This time the prick is shallow, prick a little deeper."

"The time for extracting the detoxification juice cannot be too short, otherwise the effect will not be good. It doesn't matter if it takes longer."

"Yes, yes, that's it. Our Yanyan really has a good memory and can learn it once taught."

After a long time, the detoxification was completely completed. Jun Qingyan pulled out the silver needle from Xie Lin's body and asked him, "How do you feel now?"

"There is some weakness in the arm, but other than that, there is no other discomfort."

"This is normal." Jiang Jinyue explained, "The body needs to adapt to the effect of the medicine. The medicine is all used on your arm, so you will feel that you can't exert your strength. It will be fine in an hour or two. Then again, everything is fine, why did you get bitten by a snake?"
